headline: Christmas in *West Philly*.
footer: {nights} nights in West Philly, and Christmas Day with Jabari’s mom.

sections.title: The shape of the week
sections.note: Two fixed points. The rest is deliberately empty.

items.detail: Straight up from Miami after checkout, on a flight not bought yet. The Airport Line runs from every PHL terminal to 30th Street in about twenty minutes, then it is a short ride west. Cheaper than a cab and usually faster at that hour.
Five days with nothing in them. Jabari is working some of it, so these are the days for the cards below, or for none of them.
The one fixed point in the week. Almost nothing in the city is open, SEPTA runs a Sunday timetable, and that is rather the point of spending it indoors.
Boxing Day is not a holiday in the US, so the 26th is an ordinary Saturday. Anything missed because of Christmas is open again, and busy with it.
Salvador is off, so no flight sets the end of the week any more. The 27th is a rough edge rather than a deadline.

sections.title: Eating
sections.note: Three that came recommended. The rest is Jabari’s local knowledge.

items.name: Toast Cafe
items.detail: West Philly brunch, open since 2022. Oxtail and grits, fish and grits, praline french toast. Closed Mondays and shuts mid afternoon, so it is a morning plan or it is nothing.

items.name: Booker's
items.detail: Southern-leaning New American on Baltimore Avenue, open since 2017. Lunch 10:00 to 14:30, dinner 17:00 to 22:00, and the gap between them has caught people out.

items.name: Umami Steak and Sushi
items.detail: Steaks and sushi in a basement room off Washington Square. Across the river in Center City rather than round the corner, so it is a proper evening out. Steaks $42 to $65.

sections.intro: Short list, because most of this week does not need one, and the flight up from Miami is the only one in it.

items.label: The flight up from Miami
items.detail: Saturday the 19th, after the 11:00 checkout. Not bought yet.

items.label: Magic Gardens
items.detail: Timed tickets that do sell out. Closed Tuesdays, and 22 December is the only Tuesday in the week, so that day is out either way.

items.label: A table for the 26th
items.detail: The Saturday after Christmas is one of the busiest restaurant nights of the year. Booker’s and Umami both want calling ahead for it.

items.label: Somewhere to sleep
items.detail: Nothing to book. It is Jabari’s place, which is why this is the shortest list on the site.

sections.caveat: Opening hours here were checked in September 2026, and holiday hours are the ones most likely to have moved since. Anything on the 24th, 25th or 26th is worth a phone call rather than a website.
